## Monthly_Demand

```{r}
df <- read_csv("nics-firearm-background-checks.csv")

territories <- c("Guam", "Mariana Islands", "Puerto Rico", "Virgin Islands")
df <- df %>% filter(!state %in% territories)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    month         = as.Date(paste0(month, "-01")),
    year          = year(month),
    demand_checks = handgun + long_gun + multiple + permit + other
  ) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023))

national <- df %>%
  group_by(month, year) %>%
  summarise(demand = sum(demand_checks), .groups = "drop")

year_colors <- c(
  "2019" = "#6366F1",
  "2020" = "#DC2626",
  "2021" = "#EA580C",
  "2022" = "#16A34A",
  "2023" = "#2563EB"
)

fig1 <- ggplot(national,
               aes(x = month, y = demand / 1e6,
                   colour = factor(year),
                   group  = factor(year))) +
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = as.Date("2020-03-01"),
           xmax = as.Date("2020-12-31"),
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#DC2626", alpha = 0.07) +
  annotate("text",
           x = as.Date("2020-07-15"), y = 9.6,
           label  = "COVID surge\n(Mar–Dec 2020)",
           colour = "#DC2626", size = 3,
           fontface = "italic") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = year_colors, name = "Year") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(suffix = "M", accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "6 months",
    date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  labs(
    title    = "National Monthly Demand Checks — 2019 to 2023",
    subtitle = "Sum of handgun + long gun + multiple + permit + other checks across all 50 states",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Demand Checks (millions)",
    caption  = "Territories excluded. demand_checks = handgun + long_gun + multiple + permit."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "#6B7280", size = 9),
    plot.caption     = element_text(colour = "#6B7280", size = 7.5),
    legend.position  = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )

print(fig1)

```

## Total Share
```{r}
nat_comp <- df %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    handgun  = sum(handgun),
    long_gun = sum(long_gun),
    multiple = sum(multiple),
    permit   = sum(permit),
    other    = sum(other),
    totals   = sum(totals),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    handgun_sh  = handgun  / totals * 100,
    longgun_sh  = long_gun / totals * 100,
    multiple_sh = multiple / totals * 100,
    permit_sh   = permit   / totals * 100,
    other_sh    = other    / totals * 100
  ) %>%
  select(year, handgun_sh, longgun_sh,
         multiple_sh, permit_sh, other_sh) %>%
  pivot_longer(-year,
               names_to  = "type",
               values_to = "share") %>%
  mutate(
    type = recode(type,
      handgun_sh  = "Handgun",
      longgun_sh  = "Long Gun",
      multiple_sh = "Multiple",
      permit_sh   = "Permit",
      other_sh    = "Other"),
    type = factor(type,
                  levels = c("Handgun","Long Gun",
                             "Multiple","Permit","Other"))
  )

type_colours <- c(
  "Handgun"  = "#2563EB",
  "Long Gun" = "#16A34A",
  "Multiple" = "#EA580C",
  "Permit"   = "#7C3AED",
  "Other"    = "#6B7280"
)

fig2 <- ggplot(nat_comp,
               aes(x = factor(year), y = share, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
           width = 0.65, alpha = 0.88) +
  annotate("text",
           x = "2020", y = 34.5,
           label  = "Handgun\npeak\n(COVID)",
           colour = "#2563EB", size = 2.9,
           fontface = "italic", hjust = -0.25) +
  annotate("segment",
           x = 1.87, xend = 1.87,
           y = 33,
           yend = nat_comp %>%
             filter(year == 2020, type == "Handgun") %>%
             pull(share) + 0.5,
           colour    = "#2563EB",
           linewidth = 0.6,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = type_colours, name = "Check Type") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(suffix = "%", accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 50)) +
  labs(
    title    = "National Composition of Demand Checks by Year (2019–2023)",
    subtitle = "Shares computed over total NICS checks (totals column) — not over demand_checks",
    x        = "Year",
    y        = "Share of Total NICS Checks (%)",
    caption  = "Source: FBI NICS dataset. 50 states, territories excluded."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "#6B7280", size = 9),
    plot.caption       = element_text(colour = "#6B7280", size = 7.5),
    legend.position    = "right",
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

print(fig2)
```

## PCA Analysis

```{r}

df <- df %>% mutate(
  grp_purchase = handgun + long_gun + multiple + other + permit,
  grp_private  = private_sale_handgun + private_sale_long_gun +
                 private_sale_other,
  grp_rental = rentals_handgun + rentals_long_gun,
  grp_secondary = prepawn_handgun + prepawn_long_gun +
      prepawn_other + redemption_handgun + redemption_long_gun +
      redemption_other,
   grp_returns = returned_handgun +
      returned_long_gun +  returned_other + return_to_seller_handgun +
      return_to_seller_long_gun + return_to_seller_other)

state_year_grp <- df %>%
  group_by(state, year) %>%
  summarise(
    purchase_demand = sum(grp_purchase, na.rm = TRUE),
    private         = sum(grp_private, na.rm = TRUE),
    rental          = sum(grp_rental, na.rm = TRUE),
    secondary      = sum(grp_secondary, na.rm = TRUE),
    return          = sum(grp_returns, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

labels  <- state_year_grp %>% select(state, year)

pca_mat <- state_year_grp %>%
  select(purchase_demand, private, rental, secondary, return) %>%
  scale()

pca_result <- prcomp(pca_mat, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

# Flip PC1 if purchase loads negative
if (pca_result$rotation["purchase_demand", "PC1"] < 0) {
  pca_result$rotation[, "PC1"] <- -pca_result$rotation[, "PC1"]
  pca_result$x[, "PC1"]        <- -pca_result$x[, "PC1"]
}

scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)
scores$state <- labels$state
scores$year  <- labels$year

scores_avg <- scores %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2), .groups = "drop")

loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation[, 1:2])
loadings$variable <- rownames(loadings)

scale_factor <- max(abs(scores_avg[, c("PC1","PC2")])) /
                max(abs(loadings[, c("PC1","PC2")])) * 0.45

loadings$PC1_scaled <- loadings$PC1 * scale_factor
loadings$PC2_scaled <- loadings$PC2 * scale_factor

var_exp <- round(summary(pca_result)$importance[2,] * 100, 1)

biplot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = scores_avg,
             aes(x = PC1, y = PC2),
             colour = "#2563EB", alpha = 0.6, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text_repel(data = scores_avg,
                  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = state),
                  size = 2.8, colour = "#6B7280",
                  max.overlaps = 20) +
  geom_segment(data = loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0,
                   xend = PC1_scaled,
                   yend = PC2_scaled),
               arrow     = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
               colour    = "#DC2626",
               linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_label(data = loadings,
             aes(x     = PC1_scaled * 1.15,
                 y     = PC2_scaled * 1.15,
                 label = variable),
             colour     = "#DC2626", size = 3.2,
             fill       = "white",
             label.size = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#9CA3AF", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#9CA3AF", linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title    = "Biplot — PC1 vs PC2 (Purchase_demand, Private, Rentals, Secondary, Return)",
    subtitle = paste0("PC1 = ", var_exp[1], "% variance  |  ",
                      "PC2 = ", var_exp[2], "% variance  |  ",
                      "Arrows = group loadings  |  ",
                      "Points = state averages"),
    x       = paste0("PC1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
    y       = paste0("PC2 (", var_exp[2], "%)"),
    caption = "Each point = average PC score across 2019–2023 for that state."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "#6B7280", size = 9),
    plot.caption     = element_text(colour = "#6B7280", size = 7.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(biplot)
```
